scheduleCustomClaimFee(address,uint64).details: Allows the contract owner to modify the claim fee associated with a specific underlying token. The new fee becomes effective after a delay of 1 hour, aiming to provide a buffer for users to be aware of the upcoming fee change. This function updates the fee and schedules its activation, ensuring transparency and predictability in fee adjustments. The fee is specified in wei, allowing for granular control over the fee structure. Emits a `CustomClaimFeeChange` event upon successful fee update. Requirements: - The caller must have owner privileges to execute this function.

params.newFeeValue: The new claim fee amount to be set, in wei, to replace the current fee after the specified delay.

scheduleCustomCreationFee(address,uint64.details: Allows the contract owner to modify the creation fee associated with a specific underlying token. The new fee becomes effective after a delay of 1 hour, aiming to provide a buffer for users to be aware of the upcoming fee change. This function updates the fee and schedules its activation, ensuring transparency and predictability in fee adjustments. The fee is specified in wei, allowing for granular control over the fee structure. Emits a `CustomCreationFeeChange` event upon successful fee update. Requirements: - The caller must have owner privileges to execute this function.

params.newFeeValue: The new creation fee amount to be set, in wei, to replace the current fee after the specified delay.

scheduleCustomTransferFee(address,uint64.details: This function allows the contract owner to adjust the transfer fee for an underlying token. The fee adjustment is delayed by 1 hour to provide transparency and predictability. Fees are calculated with precision to 18 decimal places, where 1 ether equals 100% fee. The function enforces fee limits; `newFeePercentage` must be within the predefined 0-`MAX_TRANSFER_FEE` bounds. If the custom fee was previously disabled or set to a different value, this operation schedules the new fee to take effect after the delay, enabling it if necessary. Emits a `CustomTransferFeeChange` event upon successful execution. Requirements: - Caller must be the contract owner. - `newFeePercentage` must be within the range limited by `MAX_TRANSFER_FEE`.

params.newFeePercentage: The new transfer fee percentage to be applied, expressed in ether terms (18 decimal places) where 1 ether represents 100%.

createVestingToken deploys an immutable EIP1167 clone to the fixed implementation and initializes only typed name/symbol/underlying token and milestone tuples; no arbitrary init bytes, call targets or code can be supplied. No funded claim is promised; no asset legitimacy, token behavior or economic endorsement is asserted.

addRecipient/addRecipients pull only msg.sender underlying tokens and mint vesting-ledger receipts to designated recipients under the already fixed schedule, with no administrator assignment. Minting uses actual received balance delta; batch allocations prorate actual received amounts and floor each allocation for tax tokens. Amounts are underlying-token base units, not 18-decimal percentages. No native value is permitted for these nonpayable funding calls.

Milestone percentages use 1e18=100%, timestamps use seconds and ramp enum 0=cliff/1=linear. Late funding inherits the existing absolute-time unlock percentage rather than restarting vesting. Claimable amount floors unlocked percentage times historical allocation, subtracts transfer-adjusted claimed metadata, burns caller receipts, and pays only msg.sender. No permit, transfer, approval, imports, role grants, arbitrary executor or transfer-helper capability is included.

claim is payable and nonReentrant; when configured claim fee is nonzero, msg.value must equal the exact current wei fee and is forwarded to configured collector. If fee is zero, source does not refund unexpected msg.value; send zero. Factory creation fee requires at least configured wei fee when nonzero and forwards the whole msg.value (no excess refund); with a zero creation fee unexpected value remains in factory. Pay only the required fee; native value limits and independent policies still apply.

Factory fee owner can change global/custom fees and fee collector subject to source scheduling; clone permanent custom fee may instead bind its fees at creation. No fee-admin methods are admitted. Fee payment is a fixed financial fee transfer, not arbitrary execution. Tokens may have loss, transfer taxes, rebases or malicious callbacks; no protection or unconditional payout guarantee. There is no withdrawal queue.

Deployment lineage uses current primary v3.1 address documentation, explorer factory internal creation and clone implementation resolution, plus observed clone runtime and manager reads. The queried creation receipt returned null from the public RPC; no receipt/log validation is claimed. Full deployed implementation ABI/source is preserved; clone source binding is immutable-runtime delegation, not separately verified clone Solidity.
